assessment: This study presents a valuable finding on the unique role of VEGFA-FLT1-AKT1 signaling in regulating muscle stem cell (MuSC) survival. The evidence supporting the claims is convincing, with multiple approaches utilized, including pharmacological and genetic methods performed in vitro and in vivo, demonstrating that the VEGFA-FLT1-AKT1 axis protected MuSCs from apoptosis. The work will be of broad interest to researchers in the MuSC biology field and support the future development of VEGFA and FLT1 targeted therapies for various diseases, such as cancer and neuromuscular diseases.
